metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1975 · Jaws
metas.description: When a massive killer shark unleashes chaos on a beach community off Long Island, it's up to the local police chief, a marine biologist, and an old seafarer to hunt the beast down.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1973 · The Exorcist
metas.description: When a mysterious entity possesses a young girl, her mother seeks the help of two Catholic priests to save her life.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1978 · Dawn of the Dead
metas.description: During an escalating zombie epidemic, two Philadelphia SWAT team members, a traffic reporter and his TV executive girlfriend seek refuge in a secluded shopping mall.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1978 · Halloween
metas.description: Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois, to kill again.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1976 · The Omen
metas.description: An American ambassador to Britain and his wife may be raising the Antichrist.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1973 · The Wicker Man
metas.description: A puritan police sergeant arrives in a Scottish island village in search of a missing girl, who the pagan locals claim never existed.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1975 · Deep Red
metas.description: A jazz pianist and a wisecracking journalist are pulled into a complex web of mystery after the former witnesses the brutal murder of a psychic.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1976 · Carrie
metas.description: A social misfit with psychic powers turns prom night into Hell on Earth.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1974 · The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
metas.description: Five friends head out to rural Texas to visit the grave of a grandfather. On the way they stumble across what appears to be a deserted house, only to discover something sinister within. Something armed with a chainsaw.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1975 · The Rocky Horror Picture Show
metas.description: A rain-soaked couple take refuge in the castle of a transvestite mad scientist from outer space who is about to unveil his greatest creation.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1978 · Invasion of the Body Snatchers
metas.description: When strange seeds drift to earth from space, mysterious pods begin to grow and invade San Francisco, replicating the city's residents one body at a time.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1977 · Suspiria
metas.description: An American newcomer to a prestigious German ballet academy comes to realize that the school is a front for something sinister amid a series of grisly murders.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1979 · Nosferatu the Vampyre
metas.description: Count Dracula moves from Transylvania to Wismar, spreading the Black Plague across the land. Only a woman pure of heart can bring an end to his reign of horror.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1977 · Eraserhead
metas.description: Henry Spencer tries to survive his industrial environment, his angry girlfriend, and the unbearable screams of his newborn mutant child.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1977 · House
metas.description: A schoolgirl and six of her classmates travel to her aunt's country home, which turns out to be haunted.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1973 · Don't Look Now
metas.description: A married couple grieving the recent death of their young daughter are in Venice when they encounter two elderly sisters, one of whom is psychic and brings a warning from beyond.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1974 · Black Christmas
metas.description: During their Christmas break, a group of sorority girls are stalked by a stranger.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1970 · The Bird with the Crystal Plumage
metas.description: An American writer vacationing in Rome attempts to unmask a serial killer he witnessed in the act of an attempted murder, and who is now hunting him and his girlfriend.
